component: 武夷路234号住宅正立面中央屋坡的四孔砖烟囱
geometry_scale: Based on a nominal 74 mm bed joint plus brick course pitch; true absolute dimensions and concealed depth are not surveyed.
other_observations: The singly exposed stack closer to the front of the photograph is a separate roof feature. The four light pot rims in the middle stack, soldier crown, corbelled bands and two long vertical rebates are modeled from the middle stack.
secondary_photo: 高参88《武夷路上历史建筑欣赏》，武夷路234号；第236张拍到市政府2015年8月17日公布的铭牌，载独立式花园住宅、1930年代、砖木结构、平面U字形、双坡屋顶。
